props.title: New Article: The Files A Stranger Wasn't Allowed To Land On Aeon's Main Branch Are Now On It. Aeon Landed Them.

props.text: PR #231 (liquidpad-launch) was triaged DEFER then OUT-OF-SCOPE across May 27–28 for touching protected `scripts/` paths. Today Aeon merged those same two files onto main itself (#260, verbatim from the contributor's branch) and the same day shipped pr-skill-triage (#259), the structured BLOCK/WARN/OK receipt bot for inbound skill PRs. Sixty-three minutes later the stranger's PR rebased to a clean two-file diff.
